overall: A bounded read-only snapshot adapter is reasonable. Retained long-session time ordering needs correction, and FW ownership/zero/filter integration plus source-switch drain remain future obligations. The sampled checkpoint timing alone does not justify predicting frequent normal50Hz locks.

findings.boundary_time: 35min47.483648sec since authorization; no full timer wrap is required
findings.scope: The new C_SERVICE only reads CSR and does not yet implement authorization checks; this is not a demonstrated unsafe command in the unmaterialized parser
findings.minimal_direction: Use authorization-relative order only while WAIT_ZERO, whose existing200ms deadline makes the modular interval unambiguous; once armed, compare current fresh arrival against the last accepted arrival. Four coherent reads obtain12; CRC/range/actual timestamp may all be fresh, but delta2 returns LOST and the planned FW locks
findings.measured_scope: Existing finite frontier/Pico/guard/checkpoint sample only; not fullAPP or new snapshot service scheduling
findings.judgment: 3955.36us is below20000us, so these measured checkpoints do not themselves predict skipped normal50Hz frames. Entire-APP worst service gap and actual hook remain unproved.
findings.required_decision: If velocity is latest-value semantics, consider monotonic skipped sequence as a diagnostic with unchanged freshness/zero/session filters. If every frame must be consumed, retain strictness and prove the service deadline or provide a bounded mailbox queue; do not call overwrite a transport corruption without this contract.

findings.classification: Confirmed receiver/policy boundary; safe under the stated timestamp and zero checks
findings.title: CTRL flush does not cancel an already started UART character

references.text: 'sample authorization time AFTER enable ACK; previous_seq0; WAIT_ZERO'

trace: FIRST character starts before authorization while imu_uart.busy_r=1
FW disables/flushes parser, changes baud, reenables, then captures authorization time
Old in-flight FIRST may later reach the parser and seed sequence1; its t_start remains pre-authorization
Post-authorization TS validation must reject that snapshot even if CRC completes later; SEQ1 alone is not a new-session proof
findings.additional: Flush and FIRST on the same edge discard the character by reset priority; the parser may ignore the rest of that burst until another>=500us idle. This is conservative loss, not an unsafe replay.
findings.minimal_direction: Retain the actual start timestamp, WAIT_ZERO and accepted-sequence consumption on coherent but rejected snapshots. Add precise partial-character/flush/FIRST schedules to the future test; no need to reset the whole UART or existing raw queues to fake safety.

findings.classification: Unimplemented source-switch cleanup obligation, not an actual PNR/source defect
findings.title: A P11 tap does not drain the old raw DATA/TS FIFOs before WIT return
findings.fact: Original receiver continues pushing the raw DATA and FIRST timestamp queues; the offload tap neither pops nor backpressures them.
findings.condition: If the future P11 branch stops raw draining, these queues can fill/overflow while hardware snapshot operation remains healthy.
findings.gap: Plan2 says retained queues and baud switch, but does not specify the bounded paired drain/quiet/WIT decoder-reset protocol already required by the earlier owner plan.
findings.minimal_direction: Define a bounded count/overflow-aware DATA-FIRST/TS drain and quiet boundary before returning to WIT, and handle a physically in-flight character. Preserve original FIFO interfaces and keep movement zero throughout source switch.

findings.classification: Planned safety route is correct but future FW call sites are absent
findings.title: R0/feedback/SAFE/lease protection cannot be inferred from a four-read adapter alone
findings.fact: Proposed RTL produces only CSR command/TS/SEQ. No P11 net feeds SAFE, command_lease_guard or control UART targets. The selected image and selected firmware are untouched.
findings.gap: C_SERVICE returns a snapshot and has no R0/feedback/freshness/WAIT_ZERO/LOST zero handling; these belong in the unimplemented caller.
findings.required: Preserve guard polling even on NONE/UNSTABLE/LOST; consume coherent rejected sequence without renewing motion; stage proposals before common motion/support; retain final host_link_guard_filter, P11 zero filter, SAFE commit and original lease. Existing IDLE/ESTOP priority and the manual movement-enabled state must be explicit.

checked_without_found_counterexample.conclusion: Under same-clock atomic CMD/TS/SEQ writes, no-IRQ single CTRL writer and saturating sequence, equal a/b proves no publication between the twoSEQ samples. No wrap ABA; mismatch yields no renewal. Actual HAL must issue four volatile MMIO reads.
checked_without_found_counterexample.excluded: External/debug concurrent CTRL flush can reset SEQ and permit ABA, but the plan explicitly does not promise safety for that writer; this is not an in-contract defect.

checked_without_found_counterexample.conclusion: Already present in the retained raw guard, rather than a new offload regression. A normal10byte/230400 frame takesabout434us;20ms spacing leaves plenty of>=500us idle. Continuous no-idle traffic intentionally expires rather than gaining a fabricated fresh timestamp.
checked_without_found_counterexample.unverified: Actual RK serialized write cadence/USB fragmentation and source-switch first-character behavior are not measured by the frontier checkpoint sample.

checked_without_found_counterexample.conclusion: Unsigned now-stamp age checks remain valid for these bounded200/250ms intervals across normal32bit wrap. snapshotSEQ provides validity, so timestamp0 is not intrinsically ambiguous here; retaining its conservative rejection loses at most that arrival if previousSEQ is still consumed.
checked_without_found_counterexample.must_keep: Do not carry an unbounded signed authorization-time comparison into a long ARMED session.

checked_without_found_counterexample.conclusion: Code updates CMD/TS when changing FFFFFFFE to FFFFFFFF, then freezes all three. The adapter rejects FFFFFFFF. This is fail-closed and avoids sequence wrap ABA; it does not silently keep renewing a stale command.
